description: Live car and engine state, lap/link context, and historical traces from the openlaps stable read surface.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every rule in the openlaps folder that is firing right now, wherever you are looking. Acknowledge on the annunciator (notifier, port 8086); this strip shows, it does not silence.

panels.title: Oil pressure
panels.description: Gauge pressure in psi, converted from the ECU's kPa in-panel.

panels.title: Manifold pressure
panels.description: Gauge pressure: the ECU's absolute reading less 101.3 kPa, in psi, so vacuum reads negative and boost positive.

panels.title: Fuel pressure
panels.description: Gauge pressure in psi, converted from the ECU's kPa in-panel.

panels.title: Fuel level
panels.description: Haltech FUEL_LEVEL as reported by the ECU, in litres. Colour steps are a generic low-fuel warning; the strategy service on the Fuel dashboard owns the real laps-to-dry call.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value AS "Surge switch" FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.surge_tank_switch' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel status
panels.description: Surge tank float switch (PDM16 SPI 1). 5 V with fuel in the surge tank; below 2.5 V the surge light is on and the panel turns red and reads LOW FUEL. Shows the newest sample in the database on every dashboard refresh, because the switch only reports every 5 s and a streaming panel sits on No data between reports. If the car drops offline this holds its last reading.

The strategy service's counter-based fuel remaining: the last anchor (full tank, operator fuel mark, or the surge switch closing, which re-anchors to 1.8 L) minus the Haltech fuel-used counter since then, carried across engine restarts. Updates about once a lap. It only rises after a stop once the refuel is recorded in session control.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, fuel_remaining_l AS "Fuel remaining" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel remaining (counter)
Gearbox oil temperature
panels.description: Haltech GEARBOX_OIL_TEMPERATURE, converted from Kelvin in-panel. Colour steps (110 / 130 °C) are generic placeholders, not limits set for this gearbox.

panels.title: Inlet air temperature
panels.description: Haltech AIR_TEMPERATURE (the inlet air sensor), converted from Kelvin in-panel. Colour steps (60 / 80 °C) are generic placeholders, not limits set for this engine.

panels.title: Current lap
panels.description: Running clock from the vehicle, m:ss.t.

panels.title: Last lap
panels.description: Definitive completed lap, 0.001 s.

panels.title: Best lap
panels.description: Definitive best lap, 0.001 s.

panels.title: Delta to best
panels.description: Signed tenths against the best lap.
Vehicle-side age of the oldest unacknowledged publish; this value goes stale when the radio link drops.
panels.title: Publish lag

panels.description: Capture timestamp carried by the newest link-health MQTT message. A dead link leaves this visibly stale rather than zeroing it.
panels.title: Newest live update

panels.description: Surge tank float switch voltage (PDM16 SPI 1), lowest reading in each interval so a blip of a fraction of a second still shows. 5 V is fuel in the surge tank; a drop towards 0 V is the switch closing (surge light). Widen the time range to see how often it blips.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS time, min(value) AS "Surge switch lowest"
FROM v_samples_named
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'
  AND channel = 'car.surge_tank_switch'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Surge tank switch

panels.description: Driver's pedal against the drive-by-wire throttle blade, both in percent on one axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS time, avg(avg) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.accel_pedal_pos') AS "Throttle pedal", avg(avg) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.throttle_pos') AS "Throttle position (TPS)"
FROM v_samples_1s_named
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'
  AND channel IN ('car.accel_pedal_pos', 'car.throttle_pos')
  AND (
    '$session' = 'all'
    OR time BETWEEN
      COALESCE((SELECT min(crossed_at) FROM v_laps WHERE session_id::text = '$session' AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'), '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      AND COALESCE((SELECT max(crossed_at) FROM v_laps WHERE session_id::text = '$session' AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'), 'infinity'::timestamptz)
  )
  AND '$trace_source' = 'v_samples_1s_named'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS time, avg(value) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.accel_pedal_pos') AS "Throttle pedal", avg(value) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'car.throttle_pos') AS "Throttle position (TPS)"
FROM v_samples_named
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle'

list.label: Vehicle
list.name: vehicle
list.query: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.description: Opens on the vehicle this pit is deployed for (OPENLAPS_VEHICLE_ID); any other vehicle with data in the time range can be picked.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.definition: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.description: Every session this vehicle has laps in, newest first, whatever the time range.
